_schema.description: Evidence taxonomy for master-plan completion ledger rows. Reuses the canonical EvidenceBundle template instead of defining a competing bundle format.

_metadata.raw_secret_policy: raw secrets, tenant identifiers, credentials, and private data must be hashed/redacted; never paste into chat, repo notes, or checkpoints

freshness_rule: Evidence must be from the current claim or explicitly marked stale and not used for completion claims.

classes.proves: code/config/schema/docs product change exists at cited paths
command, lane, test, or static check ran and produced captured result
canonical docs, catalog, ADR, runbook, contract, or template updated or not applicable
runtime behavior has runbook/smoke/observability/rollback evidence where relevant
threat model, authorization, tenant/principal isolation, and secret handling reviewed where relevant
adversarial review ran and credible findings were fixed or explicitly rejected
grit/scaffold lock and ICM lifecycle closed cleanly
